### OpenRegister reliance

**medium**: this component relies on OpenRegister for part of what it does. 1 direct reference, 4 files reached through imports.

See the [reliance overview](./index.md#openregister-reliance) for the filterable list.

### Props

| Name          | Type                                                                          | Required | Default               | Description                                                                             |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `journey`     | `{id: string, title?: string, steps: Array<object>, successMessage?: string}` |          | `\{     steps: [] \}` | The journey to render: `{ id, title, steps[], successMessage? }`.                       |
| `runId`       | `string`                                                                      |          | `''`                  | A recorded run to resume. Empty: start a new run on the first completed step.           |
| `store`       | `object`                                                                      |          | `null`                | A run store to share with another host (for example the dialog). Empty: one is created. |
| `endpoint`    | `string`                                                                      |          | `''`                  | Run API base for the created store. Empty: OpenRegister's journey-run API.              |
| `submitLabel` | `string`                                                                      |          | `''`                  | Label of the final Submit button. Empty: "Submit".                                      |

### Events

| Name          | Payload | Description                                                       |
| ------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `run-started` | —       | Emitted when a new journey run starts. Payload: the run id.       |
| `step`        | —       | Emitted when the journey moves to another step.                   |
| `submitted`   | —       | Emitted when the run was submitted. Payload: the server's result. |
